title: lessdumbaffinity
description: Affinity's Impending Doom Arrows no longer apply their respective effect, 'patching' a plethora of incompatibility issues (mainly Enchancement).
body:
when the Impending Doom effect from Affinity ends, the entity with the effect will immediately die. it was designed to be applied in a very specific circumstance by the mod's 'totems', and was thus never designed to be used offensively like how it can be used when the user has the mod Enchancement installed, which adds an enchant that allows bows to give any random negative effect. this is very obviously not an intentional interaction

this mod implements a simple patch: Impending Doom arrows can no longer apply the Impending Doom effect.
